verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that can summarize, explain, and edit files and handle multi-step reading, searching, and writing tasks. It is grounded in the user's indexed files and Mind notes via natural-language search and an automatic 'second brain' memory. Nothing documents user controls over which data the assistant can see; sharing permissions and MCP OAuth are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented controls over AI data access/scope, explicit grounded Q&A with citations to notes, independent hands-on corroboration of assistant quality.
